FOCUS PX White ATX 3.1
Following the well-established legacy of the Seasonic FOCUS Series, the FOCUS PX White ATX 3.1 v5 builds upon this foundation with enhanced thermal performance, refined acoustic behavior, and improved real-world efficiency. This is the renewed center of attraction
Fully compliant with the ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 standards, it integrates OptiSink™ technology, OptiSilent fan control, and a native dual color 12V-2×6 cable in a compact 140 mm form factor. Designed to support the latest high-performance GPUs and processors, the FOCUS PX White ATX 3.1 Series delivers stable, efficient, and reliable power for modern systems.

OptiTech Features
Engineering Every Watt, Perfecting Every Detail
OptiSink™
OptiSink™ enhances heat dissipation by optimizing the internal component layout and enabling more effective direct thermal transfer through the PCB. This design helps distribute and remove heat more efficiently from critical components, supporting lower operating temperatures and improved cooling performance, particularly during sustained or demanding workloads.
Advanced Thermal ArchitectureOptimized layout for efficient heat distribution
Reduced Circuit FootprintUp to 48% more internal space for better airflow
High Thermal ConductivityImproved 8x heat transfer directly through PCB
Enhanced Airflow EfficiencyBetter circulation for lower operating temperatures
OptiSilent
OptiSilent is Seasonic’s advanced fan control that balances cooling and noise through hybrid operation and real-time monitoring, ensuring quiet and efficient performance.
0dBA Hybrid ModeFan stays off at low load for completely silent operation
Digital Thermal ControlReal-time adjustment based on load and temperature
Smart PWM RegulationPrecise fan speed tuning for stable and efficient cooling
Optimized Noise-to-Performance RatioLow noise without compromising cooling performance
